summary: Remediated all four Review findings within the active SLICE-001 allowed paths while preserving unrelated work and leaving Bootstrap.client.luau and InitializationRunner.luau unchanged. ClientManifest now passes ReplicatedStorage as the derived-action root without resolving or requiring Project.Client.UI.DerivedUiActionIds; UiSystem performs lookup, Instance-class validation, and protected require during Initialize, maps either wrong-class or throwing-module failure to ActionCatalogMalformed, and therefore reaches the existing UI command adaptation as UiInitializationFailed:ActionCatalogMalformed. BaseUiElement now retains the exact identity accepted by ClaimSubtree and uses it for registered events, removal, and Clear even if the public UIElementId field is subsequently mutated; focused observable coverage proves the original event identity and successful reuse after Clear. BaseUiElement, ButtonController, TextBoxController, and FormController now emit through UiActionIds named constants. TS-TEST-013 now instantiates TextController with TextLabel, ImageController with ImageLabel, ScrollingFrameController, and ButtonController with ImageButton through public initialization/action/cleanup behavior; TS-TEST-015 exercises the relocated production UiSystem seam for both wrong-class and throwing derived sources through UiInitializationCommand and InitializationRunner, including stable failure flags and later-command suppression. Mandatory Rojo preflight passed, targeted diff/trailing-whitespace/static literal inspection passed, and controller-owned planned checks plus Studio/build scenarios were intentionally not run as required by this assignment.
